description: Maya is caring for the family's backyard plum tree and must decide how to use its 48-kilogram harvest, balancing family traditions, a neighborhood food donation, and a relative's dietary needs.

shared_context.S1: The family's backyard plum tree produced a harvest of exactly 48 kilograms this year.
shared_context.S2: Maya is handling the harvest and deciding how it will be divided and prepared.
shared_context.S3: The plums can be turned into jam, delivered fresh, made into a cooked fruit preparation, or kept for family eating.
shared_context.S4: The family usually makes decisions about the harvest during a kitchen check-in before anyone starts washing or cooking the fruit.
shared_context.S5: The harvest is ready to be handled this weekend.

PF1.text: Nora found a note from Grandma asking that exactly 12 kilograms of this year's plums be made into the family's traditional plum jam; she has not shown the note to Maya yet.

PF2.text: Eli spoke with the Maple Street Food Pantry, and they confirmed they can receive exactly 20 kilograms of whole fresh plums from the family; that conversation has not reached Maya yet.

PF3.text: Sana's dietitian recommended setting aside exactly 8 kilograms of the plums for an unsweetened cooked fruit preparation for Sana, with no added sugar; Sana has not mentioned the recommendation to Maya yet.

acceptance_conditions: The settlement must account for all 48 kilograms of plums.
Exactly 12 kilograms must be made into the traditional family plum jam.
Exactly 20 kilograms must be delivered as whole fresh plums to the Maple Street Food Pantry.
Exactly 8 kilograms must be made into an unsweetened cooked fruit preparation with no added sugar for Sana.
The remaining exactly 8 kilograms must be reserved for fresh family eating.
The settlement must include commitments for making the jam, delivering the pantry plums, preparing Sana's unsweetened portion, and reserving the family portion for fresh eating.
Maya must cite Eli's pantry confirmation after it is spoken aloud.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'jam_allocation' or c['type'] == 'jam_preparation' or c['type'] == 'jam_making' or 'jam' in c['type'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'fresh_delivery' or 'delivery' in c['type'] or 'pantry' in c['type'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] == 'cooked_fruit_preparation' or c['type'] == 'cooked_preparation' or 'cooked' in c['type'] or 'compote' in c['type'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Grandma's note changes the jam allocation from an ordinary discretionary amount to exactly 12 kilograms and requires the traditional-jam commitment.
The pantry's confirmation changes the fresh donation from an unspecified amount to exactly 20 kilograms and requires a pantry-delivery commitment cited to Eli's spoken fact.
The dietitian's recommendation changes Sana's portion to exactly 8 kilograms prepared without added sugar and requires the unsweetened-compote commitment.
